briefings.message: Stephen Kolek is the high-confidence expected starter. Left-handed hitters: hunt his fastballs, which make up 63.9% of his mix to you; he allows 0.311 xwOBA on them. Josh Jung, look for breaking balls, but Kolek’s right-handed hitter results are a small sample. Stay selective against his breaking-ball group, especially as a left-handed hitter. Turn Nimmo and Jung’s matchup edges into early traffic.
reminders: Nimmo leads off; Jung bats second.
Kolek’s starter status is high confidence; Seth Lugo is the alternative.
Be alert for Lucas Erceg late; he is available and rested.

briefings.headline: Vary the look, then hand the game to leverage arms
briefings.message: MacKenzie Gore is the only option ready to start. Target 5.0 innings with a 90-pitch limit. Mix breaking balls against Bobby Witt Jr.; avoid feeding him fastballs. The matchup and pitch-group samples are small, so vary sequences and stay cautious with the read. Change speeds with the Royals’ left-handed hitters; Gore’s left-handed hitter sample is small too. In a close game, bridge with rested Jakob Junis and Tyler Alexander, then use Jacob Latz late. Cal Quantrill is limited; save him for need, preferably one batter.
reminders: Work carefully to Salvador Perez and vary the sequence.
Use Gavin Collyer for length if Gore exits early.
